cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-iq-receiver
cc:Work.dc:description: Coherent I/Q demodulator with 2cos(omega_c t) and -2sin(omega_c t) followed by baseband lowpass filters, under x=Icos-Qsin. A local oscillator phase advance theta gives complex baseband estimate (I+jQ) exp(-j theta). QPSK example theta=30 degrees shows clockwise constellation rotation.
